steps.text: ...I always thought I was a pretty great Messenger.
I delivered packages, letters and such.
Sometimes they were sentimental, something they were valuable. Every once in a while, they were ruinous.
My father is an amazing man. He moved from Minos to Lungmen and founded Mountain Dash Logistics.
Profit, mutual interest, flattery.
These are complicated things, and kind of annoying to deal with, but I push myself.
My father once told me...
The other side of the world will be even more dazzling.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Mmm! Where am I...?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: What're you mumblin' back there?!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Quiet down, if you don't want a shiner.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Once the boss is done with the Penguins, he'll decide what to do with you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (I... these guys took me... is Texas still fighting the mafia with the rest of Penguin Logistics?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Shit... Why aren't I more useful... I'm an MDL Messenger...)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (...The car stopped.)

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: It's us. The boss got the Forte kid...

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Wait, what're you doing?!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Mr. Capone's orders.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Capone? These are the boss's orders! Who does he think he is...?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Who do I think I am?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hello, MDL princeling.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: This is our chance to be formally introduced.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...You shot your own man?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Punishing traitors ain't against the rules in Lungmen.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: That's not what I meant... what are you going to do with me?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Make a trade.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's pretty simple. Gambino's tough guy act is gonna destroy the Family for the sake of some so-called glory.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I don't want that. Lots of people don't want that. Who wants to die for no good reason?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: So I'm gonna help you with Gambino.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I don't trust you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...And I can help you deal with Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I ain't stupid. I been in Lungmen a long time. I made a lotta preparations.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Your father's an important man who owns over seventy percent of the private Messenger business in Lungmen.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And he's got some strategic cooperation with the highest levels of Lungmen's government.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No matter which way you look at it, Penguin Logistics is the biggest obstacle to your business success.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Our goal is to take over all channels of Penguin Logistics. Do us this favor, and we can talk business again.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: My father and Mr. Emperor have a very close relationship. I'm sorry, but you've played this all wrong.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: MDL is a very big company. Your father alone really has the final say?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I think you're underestimating us. It's true the Family has been through some tough times...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But in days gone by, our ancestors sat around the dark tables of Siracusa and proudly called themselves 'Sicilian.'

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Power shifts, blood's spilled, and I'm all ears.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Honestly, what do the people around your dad think of Penguin Logistics? What about Lungmen?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And what do you think?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...You sure talk about family a lot for a man who just killed his own kin.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You think I'll take your deal?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: His death was purely... business.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Yeah. Who knows if you pay in cash or bombs.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, I thought you'd be a little more mature. But here you're gonna throw your life away for some little thing that ain't got nothin' to do with you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You're scared. You're supposed to be some big shot MDL executive, but you ain't nothin' but a spoiled little brat.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Sorry. Young Minoans are famous for their boldness.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Looks like you ain't gonna change your mind.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If you'd lived, you'd see a lot more of this kind of thing. Too bad this is the end of the road for you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Grrr...! How is this rope so strong. I'm running out of time!)

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If you die, MDL'll have no choice but to call in the LGD. Then they'll get mixed up and things'll get even crazier. Which is good for me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But now we're done talkin.' Say good night, little prince.
Hey, excuse me. If you lay hands on Bison, I don't think we can call that punishing traitors anymore.
Why don't you just call it quits for today, hmm?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Who're you?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just a Messenger passing by.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...You look familiar. A Sankta with horns. You were makin' trouble for us earlier.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm honored.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: None of my Penguin Logistics reports ever mentioned you. Who are you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Um... do I have to answer that?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm just here looking for a lost package. Like a good Messenger would.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Capone, we got the place locked down. Everybody here's with you. She's on her own.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What? Are you going to move or what?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Doesn't matter to me. I'm ready anytime.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hmph... a good Messenger.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Nah. The bolt's locked and loaded. We all got our own business to worry about.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Capone!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If you wanna die, you're welcome to it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We do everything we gotta do to survive. Don't get it mixed up.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...And you don't have to talk so spooky. I'm really just an ordinary Messenger.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: A Sankta with a horn says she's ordinary? Who's gonna believe that one?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I got no reason to fight you. Do what you want.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A minute ago you were ready to go stone cold killer, now you're just letting me go?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That's how the mafia works. It's got all kinds of little exceptions I don't much like.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But if the princeling ain't gonna cooperate, and I can't kill him, I'll just have to find another way.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We'll be seeing each other again tonight. Maybe.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hopefully Gambino will have dealt with you by then. Or hey, the other way around works for me too.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...He really left.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You already got yourself out of the bindings, didn't you? Need a hand?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm fine. I can get myself up. Thanks for the help, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Where's everybody else?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Um.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heh. Your face says it all. It's been a rough one.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Their pace... it's kind of hard to keep up with.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I warned you. So you have any idea where they might be?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Texas said 'to the ends of the earth.' And that we'd meet up in an hour?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Okay. Sure. I'll take you there.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: The ends of the earth... what does that mean?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Um... The origin of the name has been lost to history, but now we can say it's one of the boss's assets. And it's like a base of operations for us.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: People come from all over, at least people moving in the underground circles.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So it's like...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's a bar.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima, ma'am, what are we doing...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We're putting a sheet over ourselves and pretending to be one big ghost. It's the quickest and easiest costume.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No, what I mean is, why do we have to dress up one big ghost...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So we can blend in with the Sauin atmosphere. People will think we're just going to a party or something.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That 'Mr. Capone' may not have gone far.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Suddenly a black-horned Sankta wielding a staff comes out all aggressive and overbearing...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A control freak like him is going to play it very carefully, right?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Y- yeah.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Speaking of your staff... I just noticed it. Are you an Arts user, Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's from a long time ago. I did actually get some serious training.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Pretty different from a certain lazy angel who sleeps all day.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh yeah...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So you've known Exusiai for a long time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Haha. We should have been able to have a nice noisy chat during your fun welcome party.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But the occasional explosion and ambush is par for the course for Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Is that right...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Something else?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I was just thinking about how even a Messenger like Mostima has times like this... what with all the mysterious rumors swirling around...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you disappointed?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No! Not at all! That was very impolite of me to say, I'm sorry!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I am a Penguin Logistics employee, after all. This great land is full of Messengers, in every nook and cranny. Adaptability is the first thing you should learn.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: There sure are a lot of first things in this business...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I just remembered, from here, we make a left, and then a right, then we go around the third alley here and... Yep. Shortcut.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's getting so late, but we only see more and more people coming out.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's the magic of Sauin.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Pretty neat, huh? There's floats and stands and parties, and even some stinky sewer steam, just over the wall.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...pretty neat. Yeah.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We're on a tight schedule. We need to pick up the pace.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Is this a graveyard?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah, only Lungmen would have a cemetery right in the center city like this.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Those people are all wearing funeral dress.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That kind of solemn mourning makes me think of my time in Laterano.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Laterano... what's that place like?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're very curious, aren't you?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I guess so. I just always wanted to see some faraway places.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But somehow I never got the chance to get any international contracts... *sigh*.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Intercity networks are a lot more developed than they used to be. You should have a lot of chances to leave.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...and the farther away you go, the more meaningful the experience.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Is traveling from country to country very difficult?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm... If I had to choose, I'd say the biggest problem is the Catastrophes. If you run into one, then all of Terra turns against you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There was this time that I left the Catastrophe Messenger's report at the transit station and I ran into one. I was a few hills away though.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The black clouds billowing around, the sky itself threatening you, it feels awful. Truly awful.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Catastrophes... if you're in a nomadic city, you shouldn't get hit.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There's a lot of other problems.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Cities move to avoid Catastrophes, sure, but that means the place you're trying to get can end up crawling away from you. Imagine that.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: That sounds pretty frustrating.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So you better make friends with some Catastrophe Messengers. And don't oversleep when you've got a date with one.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Hehe. Talking like this, it feels like we're coworkers, Mostima.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, sorry, was that a bit much?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...Hm? Oh. I was just thinking of something.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We have to go through the graveyard. Step lightly.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Do you know the origin of Sauin?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Where did that question come from? I heard it had something to do with ancient Sarkaz sacrificial practices...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sauin in fact comes from some ancient Sarkaz sacrificial rites, and long ago, the meaning of the name was even more complicated.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Most holidays have something to do with sacrifice or worship. It's just that people have been forgetting for a very long time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: People welcome back the souls of the departed, soothe whatever lingering issues they may have with the living, and send them on back.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But nobody takes these things seriously anymore.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The living sing and dance and dress up as ghosts. But the actual dead lay here in the graveyard, totally forgotten. It's not good.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: When the pressures of life get to be too much, it's kind of natural to want to do something to soothe yourself and forget...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We've all been through a lot. A Catastrophe is the surest thing in the world, after all.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: When you watch those mourners give their flowers and sweep their graves, doesn't it make you feel a little more peaceful?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: By the way, Mostima, back there you said you were looking for a lost package...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Didn't I tell you?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Someone gave me a job with a big pile of cash, the job said 'take Bison to see the world.' Mmm. Real stylish job.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: D- dad...!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And I'm testing you here. Your scores are up to me.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: ...it's so late. Nobody's out.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Oh, sweet child, growing up in my house, eating my food, and then going away just like that. Oripathy this, Oripathy that. You were always lost in your own thoughts.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Uncle Tung's doing well. Business is good. He brought an apprentice with him the last two days.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: You should be so lucky. Then you wouldn't make people worry. If you don't do good business, you have to...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Would you quiet down, mommy?

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: As hopeless as you? Light the candle already!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Where's my lighter... Oh, here it is.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: *Sigh* As soon as the stupid boy learned to smoke, he disappeared. Come to think of it, I never gave him a light. Too bad.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Too many candles. I'll light you a cigarette.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: You're really lighting a cigarette? Moron! Get a candle already!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Okay, okay, okay. Here.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Ah Faat...

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Now now, no crying on Sauin. Let's go. It's late. Let's go home and have Little Tung make us some noodles.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Noodles at midnight?

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: ...Thank you kids for coming here. It's hard to see at night. You've been a great help.
...No problem. It was on the way.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh. The wind.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's kind of chilly.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A cool evening breeze, the sweet smell of candy, and the sparkling lights of the city, this is the best Lungmen has to offer.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Did you see that magnificent golden street? Like the midnight sun.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Yeah. Is that where we're going?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: East Sunset Boulevard 1301. The door has some giant penguin graffiti sprayed on it. You can't miss it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And I'm afraid you're on your own from here.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Penguin graffiti, got it... but where are you going, Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Well, I can't look after you forever, can I?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: That's true... But you kind of suddenly disappeared last time too...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sorry about that. Let's just say I have other business to attend to.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You do your best to get along with the other kids.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: O- okay.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Good. See you around.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...Uncle Tung, what happened?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Ah Fil? I'm so glad you're okay. You hurry home as fast as you can!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Who was it? The man from the docks? The gang of kids?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: No, neither. You don't have to get involved this time. It was no big deal. Just a little setback.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Uncle.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...The old folks went to sweep Ah Faat's tomb. Not that you'd know, but he was like a grandson to them.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I saw them coming back and I thought I'd make some food for them. I ran into those men while I was bringing it...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Who did it?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...All I know is they weren't from Lungmen. Don't you get involved!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Right. Okay.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Ah Fil! It wasn't easy to get everything cleared up with the Oni...

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: To clear up the misunderstandings with Inspector Hoshiguma. I got you a job, didn't I? Don't blow this!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I know. Just rest up, Uncle.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'm going to find out what happened.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Ah FIl, damn it, come back here! Where are you going?!

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...Aiya! Why don't you listen?
Young people have their ways about them. You must be so proud.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...Lin? What are you doing here? Here to witness my shame?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You're Lungmen's premier finball master. You don't need to take a risk like this. Why not tell them?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Is the Rat King so important? If the people can't enjoy the finest finballs, what then?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Rules are rules.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: We made the rules.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...They're still rules.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: But you were beaten for no good reason. I don't plan to stay in hiding.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Pfah. Who knows what you're scheming!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Right. Let me help you up. You've been a finball master for so many years, have your skills dulled?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I still have hands. I'll just need someone to watch. You'll do the honors?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: All I want is to live my life in peace. If I take a beating, then I take a beating.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Hah hah. It's heartening to see such spirit in an old friend.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: You're the one they're after. What's heartening?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: This is heartening.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...Don't you get tired of this?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Very tired, but we all have our responsibilities to bear. We carry a city on our shoulders.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Sell your finballs. Concern yourself with nothing else.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Can you walk? What would you say to a walk with me?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I'm fine. It's no big... Aaaaaagh! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: A flesh wound is still a wound. Same as you ever were, playing the tough guy.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: ...Let us speak no more of the past. This is the life you have chosen, and you have nothing to feel guilty for.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Your finballs are a part of Lungmen. A more important part than me.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You are already free.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Then why do I never see you taking care of my business?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: ...Let's talk about something else. How have you been lately?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I've heard Lungmen cuisine is getting popular in Columbia. I thought I'd see about moving out there to...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: No.
